_comment: Accepted SHACL violations. Keyed by example path -> message -> count; NOT by focus node, which is a blank node whose id is assigned at parse time and differs between runs. The count is part of the key so accepting one occurrence cannot silently accept more. Written by validate_examples.py --write-shacl-baseline; commit it in the SAME change as whatever made the finding acceptable, with the reason in the commit message.
